li2026.paper_items: Equations 15-25, 30-57, Table II, and Table III

research_scope: Phase 13 finite-grid system-level hardware-resource optimization for bipartite HFT-style LCTC applications

baseline.distance_policy: Remove Table III rounded transmission and latency overrides; use attenuation and propagation laws at every configured distance

search_space.cost_definition: Each lever is normalized from zero at the Table III baseline to one at its configured search boundary; reduction and lifetime factors use logarithmic normalization

scenarios.description: Ding-Jiang p=0.3 beta=0.3 with a one-second stationary window; exposes fidelity-rate-resource tradeoffs.
The same Ding game with a 0.5 microsecond local window; rate and local decision speed must both pass.
Correlated asymmetric game whose Table III baseline exceeds the fidelity threshold.
No-theoretical-gap control used to distinguish physical infeasibility from optimizer failure.

notes: This is an exhaustive finite-grid result, not a continuous global optimum.
The equal-weight recommendation is one explicit engineering-effort proxy; the Pareto front is the primary cost-agnostic result.
No monetary, procurement, or technology-development cost is inferred from the normalized effort index.
The bipartite TPI system model is not reused for the distinct multiparty CAPS architecture.
